corsair.desc: Rift Corsair quartermaster (Ravenhold Harbor): red kerchief, long dark hair, cream shirt, dark vest, red waist sash, navy trousers, tall dark boots, a tally ledger

fisher.desc: oilskin rain hat, striped jumper, grey beard, dark belt, brown trousers, yellow wellies, fish basket

fisherkid.desc: small fisher kid: yellow rain hat, striped top, tiny rod

lamplighter.desc: lamplighter: flat cap, open long brown coat over a shirt, gold-buckled belt, grey trousers, dark shoes, lit wick pole

traveler.desc: generic wanderer: green cloak, rose scarf, satchel (player)

wildcaller.desc: Wildcaller (Midgard farmhand, mortal): blond mop, rust tunic, rolled sleeves, satchel, long hoe; warm hearth sparks

runeguard.desc: Runeguard (Shield-warden, mortal paladin brawler): chestnut braids, mail, leather jerkin, round shield with glowing light runes, axe

seer.desc: Seer (Rune-reader, mortal): grey hooded cloak with a stitched rune, rune-stone pouch, rune-carved staff; rune glow

stormborn.desc: Stormborn (Child of thunder, demigod brawler): bulky build, storm-blue cloak, silver circlet, stone war-hammer; lightning

grovekeeper.desc: Grovekeeper (Child of the Vanir, demigod): moss-green hair, flower crown, leaf-and-moss mantle, mushroom charms; neon green heal

cinderknight.desc: Cinderknight (Ember-born, demigod dark-knight brawler): heavy dark plate, ember hair, ash cheek marks and hands, greatsword with an ember edge

golem.desc: stone golem: mossy boulder body, amber rune seam and eyes, two-fist slam

wraith.desc: blue cold-fire wraith: hooded spectre with a cold-fire hem and tail, casts a cold-fire orb

skeleton.desc: skeleton swordsman: big skull under a dark rune helm, dark breastplate, notched sword

icegolem.desc: frost golem: the stone golem in pale ice, snowy shoulders, ice spikes, white rune light

skelmage.desc: skeleton mage: skull under a red hood, long gold-hemmed robe, crooked staff with a cold-fire orb

eldergolem.desc: Mossheart the elder golem (mini-boss): dark ancient stone, amber crystal crown, glowing gold runes, glow-flowers

runesentinel.desc: summon (Runeguard): a floating rune stone on a pillar of light

runewisp.desc: summon (Seer): a blue rune-wisp with an orbiting glyph

stormsprite.desc: summon (Stormborn): a storm-cloud sprite walking on lightning

sapling.desc: summon (Grovekeeper): a treant sapling with a vine whip

mushgolem_r.desc: radiant summon (tier III+): the mushgolem with a lit rim, crown of light and sparkles

runesentinel_r.desc: radiant summon (tier III+): the runesentinel with a lit rim, crown of light and sparkles

runewisp_r.desc: radiant summon (tier III+): the runewisp with a lit rim, crown of light and sparkles

stormsprite_r.desc: radiant summon (tier III+): the stormsprite with a lit rim, crown of light and sparkles

sapling_r.desc: radiant summon (tier III+): the sapling with a lit rim, crown of light and sparkles

emberimp_r.desc: radiant summon (tier III+): the emberimp with a lit rim, crown of light and sparkles
